sourceFull: Source: Chainalysis via CoinDesk & Fortune, 14 Oct 2026

parts: That's how fast a typical AI agent now spends after its wallet is funded.
Chainalysis counts over 138 million AI-agent payments on x402, a standard Coinbase started.
Developers fund agents with stablecoins, usually USDC.
Then the agent pays with no human approving each purchase.
It buys computing power, live web data, and code checks.
Over 87 percent of payments are under ten cents.
The catch: the amounts are tiny, and a payment count doesn't prove real demand.
For builders: if a machine can't pay you a few cents, it can't be your customer.
Late last year: seventy-three days. Now: eighteen minutes.
